entry.title: Resolution 578 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): — → Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF LATER FISCAL YEARS TO ENTER INTO A MULTI-YEAR LEASE AGREEMENT FOR ONE WIDE-FORMAT COLOR DIGITAL IMAGING SYSTEM TO BE USED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a five-year lease agreement with an estimated annual cost of $4,191.93, to be used by the department’s Traffic Division in Hilo.

Status: — → Adopted

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 578-26 - 06/03/26
